metric: Pairs shown different by a constraint-respecting database on which both queries were run (DuckDB), and pairs on which 600 random databases (400 wider ones when a query has HAVING, and every database of at most 2 rows per table) showed no difference (not a proof, not bounded verification).
correctness: Every refutation was executed on both queries, is stable under row-order shuffles, and returns the same rows with DuckDB's optimizer off; none are claimed without a database
coverage_of: The 12,477 pairs the prover leaves unknown in verieql-leetcode-proof (the other 11,517 of 23,994 are proved there): refuted, unknown (agree on every database tried) or unsupported (not run).
caveats: Full corpus (23,994 pairs). No labels. MySQL source run on DuckDB; 1,071 pairs are not run (DuckDB rejects them, mostly a table name the schema spells differently and GROUP BY positions that name aggregates). Search settings were tuned on a 1,000-pair sample (every 24th pair), so the other pairs are held out from that tuning. Measured on master 7b7ba13 (harness translation #347, HAVING-only wider search #356); prover rules merged later (cast_rules.py and after) are not rerun yet. In this row 'unknown' counts pairs that agree on every database tried and 'unsupported' counts pairs DuckDB or the parser rejects. VeriEQL marks 30 of these refutations equivalent; those read by hand differ on an empty table or a NULL that VeriEQL's bounded search did not reach. 2026-11-12 (commit 97e4a0e, whole corpus in six chunks of 4,000 with --audit): 5,129 refuted (was 5,676), 8,772 agree (was 12,460), 1,071 not run (unchanged). The agreeing column lost 3,688 pairs and the refuted column 547, while the proved column gained 4,235 (4,787 to 9,022); which old column each new proof came from, and whether the harness fixes since 2026-10-02 (a table's second key, consecutive ids) removed refutations that broke a declared constraint, was not measured. 0 wrong. Merged commit e7ad6b7, every 24th pair (1,000): identical statuses to the whole run on 97e4a0e, 0 wrong. 2026-11-17 (commit dd53ffe, whole corpus in twelve slices): the refuted count is unchanged at 5,129; 1,589 pairs moved from agree to proved, so agree went from 8,680 on main eaf4899 (the 8,772 of 2026-11-12 less what main's other rules since then proved) to 7,092. 2026-11-18 (commit 0779faa, whole corpus in twelve slices, the worker rules merged with main f6585e0): the refuted count is unchanged at 5,129; 1,778 pairs moved from agree to proved against main eaf4899, so agree went from 8,680 to 6,902 (one pair that agreed on every database in the earlier run is unknown in this one). 2026-11-18 (issue 45): the nine pairs that are no longer proved (verieql-leetcode-proof) join the agreeing column (6,902 to 6,911), where the executed search puts them when run on its own; the 5,129 refutations are not rerun. 2026-11-22 (commit 56376ef, whole corpus in twelve slices of 2,000, the same run as verieql-leetcode-proof): 5,128 refuted (5,129 before), 6,278 agree (6,911), 1,071 not run (1,072), 11,517 proved; 0 wrong. 635 more pairs are proved than in the 2026-11-18 whole run (less the nine proofs PR 46 removed): 633 came from the agree column, and the refuted and not-run columns are one pair lower each; which pairs moved was not separated, because no per-pair record of the earlier run exists and the harness changed in between how a search interrupted by the time budget is recorded (PR 51). held_out: Search settings tuned on every 24th pair (1,000); the other 22,994 pairs are unseen. 3,310 of the 3,586 pairs VeriEQL refutes are refuted here too (92%).
